exo.label: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (official names, descriptions, grades)

psn.label: PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophies (grades and PSN progress targets)

sources_note: Every trophy's name, description and grade below is as PlayStation publishes it, via Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on all 55). Each guide is our own words, built from the official description; where a description does not pin a place or trigger down, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — there is no separate task. Work the roadmap in order: story first, then the stranger strands, collectibles and exploration, the activities grind, and the money cleanup last. The platinum lands the moment the 54th box ticks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first mission of the game, so just follow the opening story beats and the mission markers. Unmissable: you cannot get past the opening without finishing it, and the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The trophy pops at the chapter's end, so keep following the gold story markers until the chapter closes. Unmissable — story progress is linear and every chapter mission has to be done to move on.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Same as Chapter 1: follow the story markers through to the chapter's end and the trophy pops. Unmissable — a chapter trophy can only be earned by playing the chapter through.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep the story moving and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Unmissable, like the other chapter trophies — no side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale. The trophy pops at the chapter's end. Unmissable — finish the chapter and it is yours.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the last story beat, and the trophy pops after it. Plan around it: do the partner trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy BEFORE this mission, while your partner is still around for story missions — after the finale those windows get scarce.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission when it appears in the story. A story mission, so unmissable — it pops the moment the mission ends. Just play the mission through; no special objective is needed beyond finishing it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission when the story brings it up. Unmissable — a story mission trophy that pops on completion. Play it through and move on.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission when it appears in the story. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends, like every other mission trophy in this list.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission when the story brings it up. Unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy pops. No extra objective is hidden in the description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission at Vice City International Airport when the story brings it up. Unmissable — a story mission trophy that pops on completion.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission when the story brings it up. Unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats menu. That means the story, every stranger strand, all collectibles and every activity this tracker lists — this is the last trophy most players earn before the platinum. Use this checklist as the count: when every other box is ticked, this is what is left, and it pops the moment the completion meter hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, wheelies, drifts and air time all feed the tally the game tracks. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so it builds up on its own if you drive fast everywhere. To farm it, chain small jumps and near misses on a fast bike along the highway; each stunt adds to the same running total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Fishing, drone races, arcade games, bowling, the Shooting Range, racing, meditation and hunting are eight of them — the ninth is whatever activity marker you have not tried yet, so work through every activity marker on the map until it pops. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit a Shooting Range and work through its challenge list — each challenge shows its gold score target before you start. Use a weapon you are comfortable with, aim for headshots where the challenge rewards them, and retry a challenge straight away if you fall short of gold; progress saves per challenge, so you can clear them in any order.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location runs its own race — enter from the Top Fun marker, fly the gate layout once to learn it, then race it clean. Cutting corners through gates costs more time than it saves, so fly the racing line and brake early for tight gates.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, the first time you win it, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins. Work through the race markers across Leonida in any vehicle class you like; street races and off-road events both count toward the same total.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and accept his challenge, then out-fish him: keep the tension in the green, reel steadily, and let the line go slack when the fish runs so it does not snap. Win the challenge and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Pick a short game on your first try; the trophy pops at the game's end screen, not at a high score, so finishing is all that matters.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is a chain of side missions — keep taking his calls and jobs until the strand ends, and the trophy pops on the last one. Side strands stay available after the story, so this cannot be missed, but do it before the finale if you want the strand done early.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Kenton's strand is a chain of side missions — follow it to its end and the trophy pops on the last job. Side strands stay available after the story, so work through it whenever it appears.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is a chain of side missions — take each job as it comes until the strand ends, and the trophy pops on the last one. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Strangers appear as question-mark markers on the map — take each one's first mission and follow the strand to its end. Eight FULL strands are needed, so do not just sample the first mission of many; finish them. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of the strands, so you need three more besides them.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy's strand is a chain of side missions — keep taking his jobs until the strand ends, and the trophy pops on the last one. Side strands stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand is a chain of side missions — follow it to its end and the trophy pops on the last job. It stays available after the story, so do it whenever it appears.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are marked on the map once you find the first one — visit each, sit down, and complete the session. They are spread across the whole state, so fold them into the exploration stage rather than hunting them one by one.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at the animal — follow his markers, approach downwind, and take the shot cleanly; a spooked animal means a long walk back to find it again. The trophy pops when the hunt is done.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — check shops, interiors and landmarks; each set needs every card in it, so track which sets you have finished and hunt the missing cards by area. You need three full sets, not just any three cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo and check-in action — open it at each marked location and log it. The count is cumulative, so log every location you pass during exploration instead of saving them all for one trip.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small objectives the game tracks across activities — races, stunts, shooting and more all feed the same total. Play broadly and the count climbs on its own; check the challenges menu to see which categories are closest to done, then finish those first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_note: Do this during the story, while your partner rides with you. After the finale, partner free-roam windows get scarce.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. MISSABLE — do it during the story while your partner is available: get to 4 stars together (rob a store, then fight back), then break line of sight and stay out of the search cones until the level clears. The trophy pops when the heat is gone and you are both free.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_note: Same partner window as Hot Together — do it during the story, before the final mission.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. MISSABLE — same partner window as Hot Together, so do it during the story. Rob a shop, keep your wanted level alive, and hit two more shops in a row without it dropping; drive between them fast, do not get busted, and do not let the level clear between robberies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or enter a new vehicle model and it counts. Work through traffic in Vice City and the countryside; rare models hide in specific areas, so vary where you drive instead of circling one neighbourhood.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus with five or more enemies in front of you — a gang shootout or a wanted-level fight works — and drop all five before the meter runs out. A weapon with a fast fire rate helps, and lining the enemies up before you trigger it matters more than raw aim.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport. Grab a plane on the airfield, taxi onto a runway and take off without a flight plan. Any aircraft counts; the trophy pops once you are airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description names Rhinos — the tanks. Push your wanted level to the top until the military rolls Rhinos in, then survive the encounter: the trophy is tied to the tanks showing up, so keep moving, use cover, and do not let one pin you down. The description does not pin down an exact trigger beyond the Rhinos, so treat a full military response as the goal.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — mask up, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before the alarm trips. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a failed attempt does not lock you out, so retry it clean.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — five separate vault jobs, each ending with a clean getaway. Plan the exit before you go in: a fast car parked close by and a route out of the search area. Each vault counts once, so five clean escapes in total.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the cops. Block the road ahead of it to force a stop, then get clear fast once the money is yours.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — the map fills in as you visit each named area. Drive the whole state: Vice City, the Keys, the swamps and the countryside all hold areas, and the counter in the stats menu shows how many are left. Mop up the last few by driving the map edge to edge.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs operations in its own turf — hit one operation per gang. The map markers for gang turf show you whose ground you are on, so work through the turfs one gang at a time and tick them off here.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take it to a spot with a view of the water — the trophy pops when the scene plays. It is a quiet moment trophy, so do it when you are passing the beach anyway.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_note: Do it on your first showroom visit in the story — the showroom may not stage the same smash-out moment again.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. MISSABLE — do it on your first showroom visit in the story: drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. The description frames it as a one-time set piece, so hit the glass on that first visit rather than saving it for later.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a full game of bowling there and finish it. The trophy pops on the follow-through, so complete the game rather than walking out mid-frame; your score does not matter, finishing does.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_note: A partnership moment — play the partner activities as they come during the story; the window may not reopen after the finale.
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague — a partnership moment with mass appeal. Our read, from the description alone: a co-op moment with your partner that the game flags as a highlight, a shared activity done well. Treat it as a story-adjacent beat and play the partner activities as they come during the story; no guide has pinned down an exact trigger yet, so do not leave partner content until after the finale.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_note: Choices are one-time — pick an option at every prompt instead of skipping past it.
trophies.guide: The description points at choices, and PSN tracks a count of 500. Our read: make 500 choices across the game — dialogue picks, approach picks and mission choices all feed the same counter. It builds up over a full playthrough, so always pick an option when the game offers one instead of skipping past it. MISSABLE in spirit: a skipped choice cannot be remade, so choose every time.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missable_note: Needs a fail followed by an immediate retry — the window is the retry itself, so do it deliberately on a short mission.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed on a second try. Our read, from the description alone: fail a mission or challenge once, then clear it on the immediate retry. If you are playing clean, deliberately fail a short mission once and replay it right away; the trophy should pop on the successful retry.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_note: A one-time strange event — it may only trigger once, so keep exploring odd locations and stranger markers.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's oddball encounter. Our read: a scripted weird event somewhere in Leonida; the description gives no location and no guide has pinned one down yet. Keep an eye on the stranger markers and odd map locations as you explore. Treat it as a one-time sighting: when something strange happens, stay and watch it play out.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — drive past on a bike or in a car and hit someone with a melee swing. Do it at low speed on a quiet street so you can line the swing up; the trophy pops on the knockdown.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from heists and robberies — hand them to your contacts to launder, and the counter climbs with every payout. Vault jobs and armored trucks are the fastest source of bills, so this trophy closes naturally once the robbery trophies are done.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food and car mods all count toward the same total. It is cumulative, so it builds naturally over a playthrough; if you are close near the end, buy up weapon mods and outfits to close the gap.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress — buy each one when it appears on the map; you need all eight, so keep cash in reserve for the last ones instead of spending everything on cars.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone with a vehicle you own and register it — ten different vehicles, one registration each. Any ten vehicles count, so use the cars you already own.

kind_notes.story: Chapter and mission trophies — unmissable, earned by playing the story through.
kind_notes.missable: Tied to a one-time window, a choice, or a single event. Do these before the moment passes.
kind_notes.collectibles: Things to find, buy or log across Leonida — counts tracked in the game.
kind_notes.activities: Things to do — races, challenges, robberies and side activities.
kind_notes.online: No online trophies in this list: all 55 are earned offline.
kind_notes.completion: The platinum and 100% completion — they land last.

missable_method: Built from the official descriptions alone: a trophy is flagged Missable when its description ties it to a single story moment, a choice, or a one-time event. Mission-completion trophies are NOT flagged — missions can be replayed, so finishing one is never missed.
